task: Fix Bedrock 400 on >64-char/invalid handoff tool names in conversation replay v2 metadata by persisting the real handoff tool name and sanitizing tool names at replay time.

key_reasoning.reason: Spans the supervisor handoff emitter (langgraph_event_adapter / coordinator), the shared callback layer (agent_streaming_callback, callback_utils._build_tool_metadata, used by every supervisor callback) and HistoryProjectionService on the replay path; passing the real tool name changes the on_tool_start contract for all supervisor_callbacks.

Closest pattern is HistoryProjectionService._normalize_tool_name with MAX_TOOL_NAME_LENGTH, and its tests already cover charset and length, so the fix reuses existing code. The risk is in recovering already-persisted bad histories (no data migration) and choosing whether legacy handoff records replay natively or as text, plus avoiding regressions in the shared streaming create_thought naming.

Root cause is verified and the fix goals are explicit. Two design choices remain open: how the real name reaches the callbacks (serialized vs metadata kwarg) and whether legacy handoff records are downgraded to text or replayed with a sanitized name.

About 3-4 source files (event adapter, streaming callback, callback_utils, history_projection_service) plus 3-4 test files across agents/, agents/callbacks/ and service/conversation/. The M calibration example (epmcdme-10202) agrees.
